brief:
Israeli forces converted a residential home in the West Bank village of Deir al-Ghusun into a military barracks, Shehab Wire reported. The conversion marks another instance of Israeli appropriation of Palestinian property for military use in occupied territories.

The village of Deir al-Ghusun, located in the northern West Bank, has faced repeated Israeli military operations and property seizures. The seized home joins numerous other Palestinian residences converted to military installations across the occupied West Bank.

title: Israeli military converts home in Deir al-Ghusun to barracks
